_comment: Shape reference only -- this example ships zeroed placeholders so that no rate is asserted by the repo itself (#3744). Rates are never committed: fill this shape in with the per-million-token rates you are actually billed at (read from Anthropic's pricing page at the time you refresh) and store it in the CHURN_PRICE_SHEET_JSON repo variable, which retro_churn_dump.yml passes to the dump. For a local run you may instead save it as price_sheet.json beside this file -- that name is gitignored. Dollars are computed when dump_churn.py runs, so re-dispatch retro_churn_dump.yml after changing the rates; with no sheet configured the churn view reports tokens only and omits dollars entirely. `default` is used for any model with no explicit entry; keys are USD per 1,000,000 tokens.
